Name: More Realistic Ponies - Horse Reskin - Change Farmer Riding
Author: OlegoKrendelki
Description:
This mod tries to make the horses look more realistic in shape and proportion.
At the moment, 22 horse colors have been created for Version 2. And 13 horse colors, 6 saddle options for Version 1.

To make the farmer look better on the new horses, has been created - additional mod. Alternative version of Horsemanship (by magimatica).
If desired, it can also be used on other reskins, just install it separately.

[b][color=#a2c4c9]what's new[/color][/b]

(V2.2)In the current update, 22 colors have been created for the horse.

(V2.1)The new version reworks the animation of the horse running sideways (see GIF). Also added support for carrot eating animation.
If you are interested in the new version, leave a comment or a suggestion of what you would like to see in this mod.

The new version also reduces length of the farmer's legs to make horse appear larger. If this is too short for you, use (Change Farmer Riding) from the old version1.


[u]Note[/u] [u]for Horse Overhaul[/u] mod and AT
By default, saddlebags are opened by pressing the left mouse button, which means inability to change the skin with scissors,
Therefore, you need to disable the main button for activating bags in Horse Overhaul settings menu
and set additional one instead



[b][color=#f9cb9c]Install[/color][/b]

Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
Use alternative textures (or change files for Adopt and Skin)
Unzip this mod into Stardew Valley/Mods.(there are 2 folders in the archive [AT] More Realistic Ponies - Horse Reskin -replacing horses,
and [CP] Change Farmer Riding -replacing the farmer's body on horseback)
(install both of these mods or one of them)

To change the sprite of horse, use the scissors tool on it (which the AT mod adds)
